profile.name: standard
profile.description: Conventional signal practice: a 15 s minimum green, long enough for a pedestrian phase. More realistic and markedly more expensive on this junction - the best plan under it is 42.50 s on heavy against 5.754 s unconstrained.

metric: mean total delay per requested vehicle
rule: Lowest validation mean of the metric among single runs and averaged ensembles whose every run obeyed the timing profile. Decided before the test split was measured.
